questionEn: Why can't hydrochloric acid be produced by the action of H₂SO₄ on NaCl in an open test tube?
questionUz: Nima uchun ochiq probirkada NaCl ga H₂SO₄ ta'sirida xlorid kislota hosil bo'lmaydi?
choicesEn: HCl is a volatile acid that leaves the mixture, shifting the equilibrium
choicesUz: HCl uchuvchi kislota bo'lib, aralashmani tark etadi va muvozanatni o'zgartiradi
